datasets.timepoints: L−92, L−44, L−3 · R+1, R+45, R+82. The metabolic panel also includes R+194.

time_basis: L and R count days relative to launch and return. Schedules vary by assay.

physiology.co2_hrv: Inspiration4 found higher cabin CO₂ was associated with higher heart rate variability in 3 of 4 crew members.
physiology.sleep: The crew reported sleep timing, sleep quality, mood and symptoms in an alertness and mood survey.

standard_measures.scope: NASA combines wrist actigraphy with sleep and mood questionnaires. Its preflight and postflight sensorimotor tests include heart rate and blood pressure.
